title: Cognition proposes Git repositories as portable agent memory
friendlyTitle: Cognition stores AI memory in normal files and Git
summary: Cognition released Agent Memory Repo as an open standard for storing agent memory in versioned folders containing Markdown, queries, scripts and source links. Sessions clone, search, update and push the repository, while a separate periodic agent can merge duplicates, remove stale entries and resolve contradictions.
friendlySummary: Agent Memory Repo keeps useful facts, notes and scripts in a folder with change history. Different AI sessions can read and update the same memory instead of starting from nothing.
whyItMatters: Plain files and Git make memory inspectable, portable between agents and easier to audit than an opaque conversation store. Teams still need access controls, conflict handling and rules for what should never be remembered, especially when several agents share a repository.
friendlyWhyItMatters: People can inspect, move and correct the memory with familiar tools. Teams still need strong rules so private or incorrect information is not saved and shared.
